annotations.title: Create or Edit a Cart Reminder

description: Create a new abandoned-cart reminder step (omit id) or edit one (pass its id from list_store_automations, kind cart_reminder): when it is sent after the cart is abandoned (delay_value + delay_unit), its message text per language, the minimum cart total, and whether it is on. While it is on, LetsBot sends it automatically on WhatsApp to the store's real customers who leave a cart, so editing an active reminder changes what those customers receive from then on; the previous text and settings are not kept. A new reminder is created switched OFF unless the merchant asked to switch it on. Use {customer_name}, {cart_total}, {cart_link} style variables only if the merchant wants them.

active.description: true = ON (customers get it automatically), false = OFF. New reminders default to OFF.

confirm.description: Consent gate — REQUIRED on every call. Pass false first: the tool then performs no action and returns a preview of exactly what would happen. Show that preview to the user, get their explicit approval, and only then call again with true to save the cart reminder.

delay_value.description: How long after the cart is abandoned, e.g. 2.

id.description: Omit to create a new reminder; pass the cart_reminder id to edit one.

minimum_cart_total.description: Optional: only carts worth at least this much (0 = all carts).

texts.description: Message text per language code, e.g. {"ar": "…"}. Required (at least one language) when creating.

title.description: Internal name the merchant sees in the panel, e.g. "First reminder".

name: save_cart_reminder
